name: Notations Universe Dock
description: The visual dock of the Notations Universe: a browser front end that renders the control plane's snapshot as a Kepler.gl map of located nodes and relation arcs, a force-directed capability graph, an operator view, a security constellation, a coordination ledger and an event timeline. It reads /v1/snapshot and /v1/events, submits commands with the current revision, and renders approved intents as approved, not dispatched. It holds its credential in memory only, never in browser storage, and refuses to send it to any origin but its own, loopback, or the one it was configured with.

capabilities.label: Kepler.gl universe map
capabilities.description: Located nodes as points sized by capability count and coloured by kind; relations as arcs; health as colour; flows from world models as extra layers.

capabilities.label: Capability graph
capabilities.description: Force-directed graph of every node and relation with a node inspector listing capabilities by mode and approval.

capabilities.label: Coordination ledger
capabilities.description: Every coordination record with status (ready, approval_required, approved, rejected) and its dispatch state, always not_dispatched.

capabilities.label: Event timeline
capabilities.description: Incremental journal events after the last cursor, with automatic snapshot refresh on cursor loss.

capabilities.label: Command console
capabilities.description: Composes register_node, declare_relation, record_observation, request_capability and resolve_coordination commands, validated with the control plane's own validator, and submits them with the current revision.

capabilities.label: Security constellation
capabilities.description: Eleven posture dimensions rendered weakest-link with coverage, severity counts and staleness, plus every node that has not been attested. Shows only what the control plane is permitted to hold.

relations.description: The dock renders the control plane's snapshot, coordination records and events.
Every command the dock submits goes through /v1/commands with the snapshot revision; without the control plane the dock only shows the bundled sample snapshot.

contracts.name: Control plane OpenAPI
contracts.summary: The only contract the dock consumes.

resources.name: sample snapshot
resources.description: Generated from the catalog for offline rendering; labelled as a sample, never live.

external_services.name: CARTO basemaps
external_services.purpose: Token-free dark basemap tiles for Kepler.gl

reference.spatial: Renders every located node; itself unlocated.
open_questions: Where is the dock hosted for the team, and which origin goes into CONTROL_PLANE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS?

corpus.holding: Nothing. It renders the control plane snapshot and holds no store of its own.

COR-008.note: Holds no history: it reads /v1/snapshot and /v1/events and keeps nothing.

COR-009.note: The only write path is POST /v1/commands with the current revision; the dock has no store to write back to.

COR-010.note: Renders approved intents as approved, not dispatched, and holds its credential in memory only, never in browser storage.
